senses.gloss: शेष (I) a. (f. षा) Remaining, other, न्यषेधि शेषोऽप्यनुयायिवर्गः R.ii.4, iv.64, Megh.i.30, Bt.xv.100.

शेष (II) m.n. 1. Remainder, residue, दृष्टे सूर्ये पुनरपि भवान् वाहयेदध्वशेषम् Megh.i.38, K.S.v.57, R.vi.76, viii.40; 2. escape, salvation; 3. anything left out, anything omitted to be said, an ellipsis. (इति शेषः is often used by commentators in supplying an ellipsis.)

शेष (III) m. 1. Name of a celebrated thousand-headed serpent who is represented as forming the couch of Viṣṇu, (See Megh.ii.47), मुक्तशेषविरोधेन कुलिशव्रणलक्ष्मणा R.x.13; 2. result, end, conclusion; 3. death, destruction; 4. an epithet of Balarāma.
शेष (IV) n. The remnants of food.(शेषे is used as an indeclinable in the sense of- (1) lastly, finally, (2) in other cases.)
शेष (I) a. (f. षा) Remaining, other, न्यषेधि शेषोऽप्यनुयायिवर्गः R.ii.4, iv.64, Megh.i.30, Bt.xv.100.
शेषा f. The remains of offerings made to an idol.
शेष-भोजन n. the eating of leavings.
शेष-रात्रि f. the last watch of the night.
शेष-शयन m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
